name: np_crash
character: A cruiser losing the road and hitting the barrier: its tyres squealing down in the slow motion, then one impact on a damped panel, a tear of metal and the tinkle of glass.
note: A collision is a short impact, a tearing tail and glass (the research note); the panel is a modal plate, the glass the existing glass_break laws; every level is a starting value. ESTIMATE: no collision recording was measured; the plate modes, the tear and the glass rate are starting values
